framework.ref: SEBI (Substantial Acquisition of Shares and Takeovers) Regulations, 2011 — Regulation 31(4)
framework.note: Mandatory disclosure requirement when acquirer's shareholding exceeds 5% or incremental 2% is acquired within 7 calendar days.
Acquisition of 25% or more, or control, mandates an open offer unless exempted under Schedule II.
Exemptions from open offer available for acquisitions from promoters, institutional investors, or under slump sale post-NCLT restructuring.

framework.ref: Securities and Exchange Board of India Act, 1992 — Section 11(4) & 12(2)
framework.note: SEBI's rule-making and enforcement authority for takeover regulations; violation triggers show-cause and penalty proceedings.

framework.ref: Companies Act, 2013 — Section 4, 5 (definition of 'promoter' and related disclosures)
framework.note: Disclosure of 'acquirer' status and related party links in takeover filings.
Listed companies must promptly disclose material events including substantial shareholding changes via exchange notification.
If acquisition valued >₹2,000 cr and meets asset/turnover thresholds, CCI approval required under Section 6(2)(c).

framework.ref: Income Tax Act, 1961 — Section 47 (acquisition of shares)
framework.note: Share purchase may qualify for exemption if structured as acquisition of capital assets; review if any gift or cross-holding angle.
